'''Jella''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Jella worked as a member of a crew of a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the craft was rented by tourists in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and Jella helped to fly them from the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uffel]]. She spent the journey aboard the shuttle's flight deck, along with her fellow crew member, [[Roya]].
